title: Work With Us | Careers and Opportunities at Stanchion
text_excerpt: Work With Us | Careers and Opportunities at Stanchion Our Offerings Verto Verto simplifies complex payment ecosystems, accelerating integration and enabling banks and providers to launch modern payment capabilities quickly and efficiently. Solutions & Services SwitchCare SwitchCare delivers proactive monitoring and expert support, ensuring resilient payment switch environments with faster issue resolution and optimised transaction performance. Professional Services Specialist integration and delivery services that modernise legacy payment systems, reduce project risk, and accelerate deployments across complex financial environments. Partner Solutions Integrated partner technologies enhance resilience, security and scalability, helping organisations streamline payments, reduce integration overhead and accelerate time-to-market. About Us Resources Careers Insights Contact Work with us Stanchion’s approach is to hire team members who contribute both on a technical level and who will be a natural fit for the team. We strive for excellence by cultivating the best team as well as work environment. What makes us a preferred employer is the global experience we offer as well as the way we work – our values are well-lived and entrenched in how we do business. We are always looking for new talent, so feel free to view our open vacancies within our global teams. View available positions Life at Stanchion Stanchion’s head office is based in Cape Town, South Africa and we have offices across the globe in Australia, Middle East, United Kingdom and America. Our teams are also spread across these regions and this results in resources liaising globally with customers, team members and receiving international exposure. We have a very bespoke offering in the payments industry and we therefore believe strongly in knowledge sharing and growing our teams from within. What makes Stanchion great is its people and the trust our customers have in our product offering and teams abilities. This is something we are very proud of! Global Diversity Even though we are a global company we still function as one team! This is accomplished by shared values, and experiences and also by making sure our teams build healthy relationships! Purpose, values and competitive capabilities. Our core purpose is powering payments change. Our business is about providing global payment application solutions. We are really good at engaging our customer as a trusted partner, providing innovative solutions and securing payment processes. Our key capabilities include integrating, automating, optimising and securing payment systems, processes and operations. Our Customers experience our culture as people who own the ticket, are trustworthy, transparent, driven by excellence and collaboration. Our hiring process Our approach to hiring is to ensure that candidates know what we are looking for upfront, making sure we tick all the boxes and answer all the questions as well as establishing a good synergy between the candidate and the hiring team 1. Find We advertise on various platforms such as our website, LinkedIn and we also use external recruiters to source candidates. 2. Enquire If you are interested in a role, you can easily view the job specs on our website and then submit your application to our careers email address. 3. Evaluation Once we have received your application, we will review your profile and experience to see if it is a good match. If it is a fit, we will contact you directly to arrange an interview with our team. We try and limit interviews to 2 rounds depending on the type of role. 4. Feedback We provide feedback to candidates after a position is filled. Our Current Vacancies Our Current Vacancies See links below to view all available roles within our teams.
